description: This is a C# source file defining a static internal class 'Constants' within the 'Orleans.Runtime' namespace. The class contains constants, readonly fields, and methods related to grain types and system target types used within the Orleans distributed framework. It mainly provides identifiers, system target names, and utility methods for handling these constants.

classes.name: Constants
classes.description: A static class holding constant values, predefined grain types, system target names, and utility methods related to Orleans system targets.

methods.name: SystemTargetName
methods.description: Returns the string name associated with a given GrainType if it is a singleton system target; otherwise, returns the GrainType's string representation.

methods.name: IsSingletonSystemTarget
methods.description: Checks if the provided GrainType is a recognized singleton system target.
